card.name: Pay and job-ranking comparisons in web text
card.fires_on: Words inside sentences that compare earnings, pay gaps or job rankings, such as 's, of, paid, best and Jobs. It also fires inside comparisons of risk size, such as three-fold.

modes.label: Pay gap wording
modes.description: Small words in sentences about women's or degree holders' earnings compared with others.

modes.label: Risk comparison
modes.description: Words inside statements of how much more likely an outcome is for one group.
modes.example: People who had multiple insomnia symptoms had a three<<fold>> increased risk of developing heart failure

card.plain: It lights up in the middle of sentences that compare pay, job rankings or how much more likely something is for one group.
